dailyArticle.title: 📰 Official Grok 4.7 status
dailyArticle.headline: xAI now publicly lists grok-4.7
dailyArticle.summary: As of November 2026, xAI's official model catalog identifies Grok 4.7 as its latest flagship for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work (announced ~2026-09-21).
dailyArticle.details: The catalog lists a 500K-token context window, May 2026 knowledge cutoff, text and image input, text output with no text output limit, reasoning effort low/medium/high (default)/xhigh, plus function calling, web search, X search, and code execution. Treat published scores as official announcement figures only.
